name: trace_id
description: W3C 32-hex trace identifier of the turn.

name: span_id
description: Span identifier of the innermost model or embedding call.

name: parent_span_id
description: Parent span identifier (outer enclosing parent when ADK Format 1 call_llm folds into generate_content).

name: client_request_id
description: bq_eval.client_request_id (x-client-request-id) correlating 1:N upstream gateway requests; never merged with response_id.

name: response_id
description: gen_ai.response.id provider response identifier; never filled from client_request_id.

name: outcome_id
description: Primary outcome.id of the span or enclosing trace.

name: trace_owner_app_id
description: Owning application ID resolved with gateway caller_app_id precedence (NULL when unregistered).

name: operation_name
description: gen_ai.operation.name (chat, generate_content, embeddings, or custom/tool operation on positive-token spans, ADR-047).

name: start_time
description: Model call start UTC timestamp.

name: end_time
description: Model call end UTC timestamp.

name: agent_id
description: gen_ai.agent.id on the call span, else on the nearest enclosing agent span.

name: agent_name
description: gen_ai.agent.name on the call span, else on the nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_name
description: gen_ai.skill.name on the call or nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_version
description: bq_eval.skill_version on the call or nearest enclosing agent span.

name: skill_sha256
description: Emitted bq_eval.skill_sha256 hex digest compared downstream against skill_registry.

name: request_model
description: gen_ai.request.model requested model identifier.

name: response_model
description: gen_ai.response.model serving model identifier (never defaulted from request_model).

name: provider
description: Normalized provider identifier from gen_ai.provider.name (or legacy gen_ai.system).

name: upstream_endpoint_location
description: bq_eval.upstream_endpoint_location upstream serving region or multi-region.

name: runtime_lane
description: bq_eval.runtime_lane execution lane (gateway -> root -> call precedence).

name: state_mode
description: bq_eval.state_mode stateless or stateful session ownership mode.

name: serving_tier
description: bq_eval.serving_tier (PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT, PRIORITY, STANDARD, FLEX).

name: traffic_type
description: bq_eval.traffic_type attribution class (platform gateway span preferred over application span).

name: traffic_type_attested
description: TRUE when traffic_type came from a platform-class span, FALSE when application-emitted, NULL when traffic_type is NULL.

name: thought_signature_present
description: bq_eval.thought_signature_present multi-turn reasoning signature preservation flag.

name: caller_retry_count
description: Directly preceding model calls in the trace (ordered by start_time, span_id) by the same agent and request_model ending in HTTP 429 (0 when none).

name: tool_definitions_sha256
description: bq_eval.tool_definitions_sha256 tool-schema hex digest.

name: available_tool_count
description: bq_eval.available_tool_count count of candidate tools exposed on the call.

name: selected_tool_names
description: bq_eval.selected_tool_names JSON array of dynamically selected tool names (NULL when absent).

name: input_tokens
description: gen_ai.usage.input_tokens prompt token count (NULL when absent, 0 when reported 0).

name: output_tokens
description: gen_ai.usage.output_tokens completion token count.

name: cache_read_tokens
description: gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens cached prefix read tokens.

name: cache_write_tokens
description: gen_ai.usage.cache_write.input_tokens single lifetime-neutral cache write count.

name: reasoning_tokens
description: gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens (folding legacy thoughts_tokens).

name: latency_ms
description: Call execution latency in milliseconds (end_time minus start_time).

name: time_to_first_chunk
description: gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk streaming first-token latency in seconds.

name: finish_reason
description: Primary finish reason from gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.

name: http_status_code
description: http.response.status_code integer status.

name: error_type
description: error.type error classification string.

name: content_missing
description: TRUE when a non-embedding model call arrived without inline messages or message reference addresses; FALSE on embeddings.

name: model_confidence
description: bq_eval.model_confidence per-call confidence score.

name: cascade_tier
description: bq_eval.cascade_tier (primary or escalation).

name: escalation_reason
description: bq_eval.escalation_reason (failure, low_confidence, missing_runbook, policy_threshold).

name: labels
description: Open-safe registered slice-only attributes JSON object.
